# Blooms Builder

> AI-integrated text bank for automatic test questionnaire (TQ) generation and Table of Specification (TOS) creation, aligned with Bloom's Taxonomy.

Blooms Builder helps educators create professional assessments by generating and classifying questions using AI (NLP + Bloom's Taxonomy), organizing them into a subject-based question bank, and producing tests aligned with a Table of Specifications.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform and its assessment features.
- [Sign In](/login): Teacher, admin, and validator sign-in.
